Substantively the claim is a special case of the textbook Tsirelson correlator/XOR-game theorem: every 2x2 correlator functional has its commuting-operator (Tsirelson) bound given by the 1+AB SDP, attained by qubits, with the standard SoS certificate lam*I-B=sum E_x^2/(2l_x) and E_x in span(S_{1+AB}). The DRAFT proof is that generic biased-CHSH proof with l0=sqrt6, l1=sqrt6/2 and s=1/4 optimization.
